description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF11 allies are alive, grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [One-Eyed Swordmaster Mode] and Temple Knight +1 to the user

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: One-Eyed Swordmaster Mode
description.text: Increases Temple Knight level by 1 (max 2) after using Savage Blade or Angel's Wings three times, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
